name_en: Shannon multigraph edge-colouring theorem (exact proposition open)

candidate_family_not_credited_as_stateme: Every finite loopless multigraph G has chromatic index at most floor (3 * maximumDegree(G) / 2), equivalently it admits a proper edge-colouring using at most that many colours.
